name: personal-assistant
description: Your asks, commitments, reviews, and deadlines from the Personal Assistant tray app.
long_description: Connects Claude to the Personal Assistant tray app running on this computer. Claude can list and search what you've been asked to do, see the context behind a request, find the local repo to work in, and record what it did. The tray app must be running. Calls go through its permission settings, approval prompts, and audit log.
